title: XOR of two independent symmetric small-bias distributions fools every bounded test

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard Fourier analysis on the Boolean cube, concentration and symmetric-polynomial identities
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Full source-local Krawtchouk, truncation and analytic proofs plus complete author bibliography retained.

core_obligations: Establish the shifted-symmetric small-bias bounds over typical Hamming-weight regions.
Transfer the symmetric analysis to arbitrary bounded tests of the XOR of two independent distributions.
difficulty_reason: Analyzes typical shifts of symmetric small-bias distributions, including endpoint/middle decompositions and Krawtchouk bounds, to prove fooling of arbitrary bounded functions. Independence, symmetry and bias thresholds remain explicit.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for exclusive DOI without neighbors. Five independent principal conclusions cover smoothed fooling, threshold-tail lower bound, distance-to-bounded-uniform lower bound, XOR fooling and general typical shifts. The author notes the two lower bounds are distinct and asks for a unifying result; they are not split parameter variants. Small-space/AC0 application corollaries and supporting claims are uncounted.
